camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; static balls/background constant to <0.5 px over frames 0-21)

intrinsics_lab_convention.note: from benchmark convention: HFOV 80 deg, f = 0.5959 x 1280

perspective.note: camera looks slightly downward at the table from in front; table side edges converge to ~(707,341); near table edge tilted ~1.4 deg (left end higher)

yellow_ball.desc: yellow-green tennis ball (felt), larger ball; starts at right-back of tabletop

static_frames_0_21.note: right hand fingers touch/cover a little; true ~29-30 px

yellow_ball.apparent_size_trend: grows ~27-30 px (f0-21) -> ~42-44 px (f41): ball approaches camera while rolling left; ~45-48 px while falling (blur inflates)

white_ball.desc: small white ball (ping-pong / golf-ball size), starts left-back of tabletop, ~130 px left of yellow ball

static_frames_0_28.note: fingers hide part of lower edge

white_ball.apparent_size_trend: grows ~15 px -> ~26 px (f48): approaches camera while rolling right; mask may include a bright specular/reflection band, bb_w inflated by blur

person.desc: seated person behind the table (face/body pixelated), hands rest on far table edge; right hand pushes yellow ball (f~21-22), left hand pushes white ball (f~29-30)
person.image_extent_px: head ~ (650-760, 380-430) behind table, knees/legs x 600-830 y 505-720

table.desc: rectangular wooden tabletop on a single central dark pedestal, centre of image
table.accuracy: +-4 px (hands and person blur the far edge)

camera_tripod.desc: black tripod behind the table with a small camera (white/blue top) on it
camera_tripod.head_to_feet_px: top y~65, feet y~660 (left foot ~(517,660), right foot ~(843,697))

left_tripod_leg.desc: black tripod/light-stand leg entering from left image edge, x 0-150, y 300-720

wall_panels.desc: grey padded wall panels, vertical seams; room corner at x~820 (ceiling junction y~150)

floor_cables.desc: red/orange and black cables on grey carpet in front of table, x 0-1000, y 560-700

watermark.desc: text 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right

events.event: yellow ball starts rolling (pushed by right hand)
white ball starts moving (pushed right by left hand)
yellow ball passes in front of white ball (no contact seen; they move in opposite directions)
dropped frame in recording between frames 35 and 36 (both balls jump ~2x normal step)
yellow ball reaches left side edge of tabletop / leaves table
yellow ball leaves image at bottom edge
white ball still rolling right/toward camera at clip end
